authority: User explicitly redirected original PR #1 to alpha-first offensive optimization and instructed continued implementation for maximum return. This is a new structural mechanism; it does not reopen or relabel profit_trend_shield, suspended_campaign, funded_reentry, revocable_reentry, ranking or funding failures.
purpose: Test whether the parent loses alpha by waiting through its ordinary readmission confirmation after a portfolio market-shock liquidation even when the exited name has already re-established itself as the strongest current executable opportunity.

premise.source_evidence: Exact f02c17d pre-2026 control accounts and frozen market input, inspected without a new portfolio replay.
premise.diagnostic_definition: After actual exit following a pure CROSS_SECTION_SHOCK or ACCUMULATED_MARKET_SHOCK, require positive replayed parent risk authority, the unchanged full current entry/ready/not-exit/positive-score conditions, deterministic rank-1 unchanged score in the current scope, current close above the saved shock-signal close, and a signal strictly before the original control account's next actual entry. Future next-open returns are diagnostic only and never enter treatment decisions.
premise.prior_failure_boundary: profit_trend_shield proved that simply holding winners through the shock is harmful in union; funded/revocable reentry and suspended_campaign proved that generic health release or privileged restoration is insufficient. The treatment therefore exits normally first and grants no persistent restoration right.

treatment.capture: Record a reclaim candidate only when an actually held position is targeted to zero by a pure CROSS_SECTION_SHOCK or ACCUMULATED_MARKET_SHOCK and no independently true account-drawdown/non-market/individual protection condition is the causal requirement. Retain the signal-close price and wait for actual zero inventory; blocked or partial exits remain protective obligations and cannot authorize reclaim.
treatment.release: Only while the parent readmission veto for that flat shock-exited campaign is still active, provisionally clear that one veto for one close if the symbol currently satisfies the parent's unchanged full entry eligibility, is the deterministic rank-1 positive score among all currently eligible names, current close is strictly above the saved shock-signal close, and current parent risk authority is positive. The parent then runs unchanged and may still reject the purchase for risk cap, cash, slots, concentration, stop distance, materiality, liquidity or execution reasons.
treatment.provisional_permission: If no actual new holding is observed, restore the original readmission veto after the decision; an unfilled request never becomes stale permanent permission. Actual reacquisition consumes the reclaim memory. If ordinary parent recovery clears readmission first, the special memory expires because it is no longer needed.
treatment.invalidation: Cancel reclaim memory on any individual exit/stale/not-ready condition before actual liquidation completes, any non-market/account protective reason, or actual reacquisition. No expected sale proceeds, shadow account, reserved future slot or guaranteed fill.
treatment.ranking: Use the existing Features.score unchanged; no score transformation, learned model, ranking weight or threshold grid is introduced.
treatment.cash_and_execution: Preserve actual cash, fees, slippage, liquidity, lots, T+1 sellable inventory, economic ceilings, mandatory protection and non-resetting actual NAV risk history.

measurement.alpha_screen: Treatment wealth must be no lower than control in all three scopes and strictly higher in at least one. Record MDD, fills, exposure, reclaim requests/fills and ledger reconciliation, but do not substitute defensive metrics for this alpha-first screen.
measurement.failure_rule: If fixed alpha screen fails, reject this mechanism. Do not add rank cutoffs, price buffers, waiting windows, symbol/date rules or nearby score thresholds, and do not run its rejected treatment over 2026/final matrix.
measurement.advance_rule: Only a fixed-screen pass may advance the same treatment to the existing full original reference, risk, bull/crash, removal, subset, cost/delay, prefix and stability acceptance requirements.

prohibitions: No trades reference source enters production.
No frozen acceptance, benchmark, data, universe, seed or cost change.
No pool-wise winner stitching or relabeling of prior rejected evidence.
